Create a resource by name

Usage: slipway create [OPTIONS] (<TYPE> <NAME> | project --from-dir <DIR>)

Arguments:
  <TYPE>  The resource type, by its plural, singular or short name (see api-resources)
  [NAME]  The name of a resource of that type

Options:
      --path <DIR>          Directory of the git repository to register
      --description <TEXT>  A short description of the resource
      --label <KEY=VALUE>   A label to set on the new resource; may be repeated
      --remote <URL>        The URL the origin remote is expected to have
      --branch <NAME>       The branch the project is expected to have checked out, written to
                            spec.branch
      --from-dir <DIR>      Register every git repository at or under DIR as a project, in place of
                            NAME
      --depth <N>           How many directory levels under --from-dir to search, 1 by default
      --dry-run             Print what would change and write nothing
  -o, --output <FORMAT>     Output format [possible values: json, yaml, name]
  -h, --help                Print help (see more with '--help')

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
